summary: Planning session on onboarding and deploys.

lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: We keep hearing that new signups don't know what to do first. I think we should ship an onboarding revamp.

lines.speaker: Rowan Diaz
lines.text: Agreed. Walk them through the first meaningful action rather than dumping them on an empty dashboard.

lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: Right. Rowan, can you own that?

lines.speaker: Sky Patel
lines.text: Separate thing — deploys are still failing halfway and leaving the cluster in a weird state. We need to make the pipeline handle partial failure properly.

lines.speaker: Jules Kim
lines.text: Isn't there a card for that?

lines.speaker: Sky Patel
lines.text: Maybe? I'll double check. Either way it needs doing.
